sourceOfTruth: This JSON is the source of truth. The prose lens in skills/software-development/critic-lens-compliance/SKILL.md is a human readable view; checklist-lint rejects duplicate IDs and SARIF ruleIds that do not resolve here. Panel machinery items (annex application, capture-recapture, inter-rater reliability, decorrelation, seed calibration, unknowns ledger, Not tested list, write gate, environment levels) are carried in the code checklist as CODE-PM-001 through CODE-PM-009 and are part of every brief, whatever lens leads.

items.title: Severity, deterministic.

applicability.predicate: always unless the surface is absent, in which case record not-applicable with the absence as the reason

items.passCriteria: Every finding's severity follows the deterministic scale in the item text (absent governing control is Critical, unenforced or unmonitored is High, no evidence trail is Medium, documentation drift is Low), and the scale is quoted in the report.
items.failCriteria: A severity is assigned off-scale, or regulated or personal data is processed with an absent governing control and the finding is graded below Critical.
items.howToTest: Inspect the artifact against: Severity, deterministic. Critical: regulated or personal data processed with the governing control ABSENT (no consent, no deletion path, no access control). High: control exists but is unenforced or unmonitored. Medium: enforced but leaves no evidence trail. Low: documentation drift.
